All.name: Aura Cleaving Weapon
All.description:
You have improved your golems offence by allowing it to energize its weapon to punch through auras.
Your golems natural attacks does an extra damage dice to auras

All.name: Ballista
All.description:
You mount a ballista on your golem, giving it a ranged weapon.
Your golem has a ranged attack (DEX + trained), 1d10 + PHY piercing damage, with the Reload 1 trait and a range of 10 tiles. 
While adjacent to your golem you may use your DEX instead of it's own DEX for the attack.

All.name: Elemental Ward
All.description:
With the right runes and spellwork your golem is now resistant to elemental damage
Your Golem has resistance 3 to elemental damage

All.name: Feathersteel Wings
All.description:
You've equipped your golem with feathersteel wings that lets it glide down and perform acrobatic maneuvers.
Your golem has a glide speed equal to its movespeed.
Your golem is trained in acrobatics or stealth.

All.name: Golem Mount
All.description:
You design your golem to serve as a suitable mount.
You can mount your golem as 1 action.
You have a +2 bonus to Reflex saves against strikes and targeted attacks while mounted on your golem

All.name: Integrated Weapon
All.description:
You've designed your golem to allow it to integrate a weapon into one of its arm
You can spend a minute to attach a weapon.
While attached it cannot be disarmed and has +1 bonus to attack.

All.name: Programmed Tactics
All.description:
You program in two tactical maneuvers for your golem.
Your golem learns two simple combat maneuvers.
This upgrade can be taken multiple times, choosing new combat maneuvers

All.name: Raise Guard
All.description:
Your golem raises its hands or appendages to guard itself.
Your Golems natural strikes has the Block 2 trait, giving an option to defend itself.
It also learns the Protect Ally combat maneuver but can only target you with it.

All.name: Soul Link
All.description:
You set up a crystal connection to connect the golem to your soul, giving you a few benefits
You can see and hear through your golems location
You can command your golem without verbal commands and the range of command is now 20 tiles 
You can recharge Capacitor Upgrades within that range.

All.name: Specialized Armory
All.description:
Your golem becomes trained in two weapon groups.
You may choose an Advanced Weapon instead of a weapon group

All.name: Defense Protocol
All.description:
After your Golem uses the Block action adjacent allies have +1 to all saving throws.
Additionally you may Take Cover behind your golem as a part of the Block action.

All.name: Project Aura
All.description:
You can project your Aura to protect your golem from dangerous attacks.
When your golem would take damage, you can use Aura Block as a reaction as long as you are within 20 tiles of it.

All.name: Reinforced Armor
All.description:
You have improved the defenses of your golem, making it even tougher.
Increase it's resistance to physical damage by 2.
Its health increases by its PHY

All.name: Size-Up Golem
All.description:
You've sized up your golem.
Your Golem is large. 
It's health is (4 x your level) + your INT + its PHY

All.name: Soul Channel Spell
All.description:
Using your Soul Link you can now channel spells through your golem.
When casting spells you may choose to cast spells as if you were in your golems space.
This gives the spell the Complex trait. 
You cannot cast spells that already have the Complex trait with this

All.name: Tail Strike
All.description:
A tail or tentacle is an unorthodox weapon for a golem, but it can it hit foes that aren't expecting
Your Golem has a Tail natural weapon, with a reach of 2. It does 1d8 damage and has the Sweep trait.
When you design your golem you can choose weather it it's an Agile tail or Shoving tail.
An agile tail also has the Agile and Finesse trait and does slashing damage
A shoving tail also has the Shove and Sweep trait and does bludgeoning damage.

All.name: Fire Capacitor
All.description:
You install a flame throwing projector in your golem.
Your golem can spend two actions to project a 5 tile cone of fire, dealing 4d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex save
After use, you must then recharge the capacitor with 5 mana as an action while adjacent to your golem.

All.name: Lightning Capacitor
All.description:
You install a lightning projecting device into your golem.
Your golem can spend two actions to project a 10 tile line of fire, dealing 3d8 lightning damage with a basic Reflex save
After use, you must then recharge the capacitor with 5 mana as an action while adjacent to your golem.

All.name: Frost Capacitor
All.description:
You install a flame throwing projector in your golem.
Your golem can spend two actions to project a 3 tile cone of fire, dealing 3d4 cold damage with a basic Fortitude save
Medium and smaller creatures that fail the save also become Frozen 1, or 2 on a critical failure
After use, you must then recharge the capacitor with 5 mana as an action while adjacent to your golem.

All.name: Upgraded Components
All.description:
With some upgraded components, your golem is now stronger or faster than before.
Increase your golems PHY or DEX by 1. 
You may choose this upgrade multiple times.
The highest you can raise them to is 5.
This limit increases to 6 at level 12, and 7 at level 18

All.name: Advanced Programmed Tactics
All.description:
You've program in more advanced maneuvers
Your golem learns two advanced combat maneuvers.
This upgrade can be taken multiple times, choosing new combat maneuvers

All.name: Battlefield Stomp
All.description:
Your golems size allows its to create a thundering stomp.
Your golem has the Battlefield Stomp action. (Environmental, attack, area)
Battlefield Stomp, 2 actions - Every creature within 3 tiles must make a basic Fortitude save against your Golems attack.
On a failure they take 2d6 bludgeoning damage and fall prone

All.name: Greater Elemental Ward
All.description:
Stronger wards have improved your golems resistance to magic.
Increase your golems resistance to elemental damage to 8
Increase it by 2 more if you have the Size-Up Upgrade, and an additional 2 if you have the War Walker upgrade

All.name: Perfected Spell Channeling
All.description:
You've set up the perfected resonating link to channel your spells
When channeling spells though your golem you no longer give the spells the Complex trait and you can cast Complex spells
You can also target your golem with spells that would normally only target you

All.name: War Walker
All.description:
You've built your golem as true war walker, a machine of battlefield prowess
Your Golem is huge. 
It's health is (5 x your level) + your INT + its PHY
It does an extra dice of damage with its attacks

All.name: Winged Golem
All.description:
You've improved your golems wings and given it magical propulsion.
Your golem has a flight speed equal to its movespeed.

All.name: Capacitor Upcharge
All.description:
You have upgraded your golems capacitors, allowing to channel more mana into destructive magic.
When using the an capacitor action you may overcharge them, increase the damage and size.
If you do, your golem becomes Stunned 1 and needs 15 mana before the capacitor can be recharged.
Fire Capacitor, 8d6 damage, 7 tile cone.
Lightning Capacitor, 5d12 damage, 2 tile wide, 12 tile long line
Frost Capacitor, 6d4 damage, 5 tile cone. Frozen status works on large creatures
